codes.validation_failed: Some data is not valid. Check it and try again.
codes.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
codes.not_found: This item was not found (it may have been deleted, or you are not a member).
codes.conflict: This cannot be done because the data conflicts (for example a duplicate name or an archived project).
codes.email_taken: An account with this e-mail already exists. Try signing in instead.
codes.invalid_credentials: The e-mail or password is wrong.
codes.invitation_invalid: This invitation link can no longer be used (expired, cancelled or already used).
codes.last_owner: There must always be at least one owner.
codes.personal_workspace: This cannot be done in a personal workspace. Create a company workspace first.
codes.unprocessable: This data cannot be calculated, so it was not saved.
codes.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
codes.internal: The server had a problem. Try again.
codes.otp_invalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Request a new code and try again.
codes.ai_unavailable: The AI assistant is not available right now. Try again later.
codes.ai_quota: The AI assistant has no credits left. Contact your administrator.
codes.network_error: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
codes.invalid_response: The server sent an invalid answer.

reasons.baseline_locked: The BOQ baseline is locked and cannot be changed.
reasons.already_issued: This document has been issued and cannot be changed.
reasons.invalid_transition: This status change is not allowed from the current status.
reasons.missing_dependencies: Switch on the required modules first.
reasons.not_entitled: This workspace is not entitled to this module yet.
reasons.has_dependents: This cannot be deleted because other data refers to it.
reasons.document_issued_exists: This cannot be done because issued documents exist.
reasons.trial_used: This workspace has already used the trial of this module. A trial can only be used once.
reasons.already_entitled: This workspace is already entitled to this module.
reasons.entitlement_revoked: The entitlement to this module was revoked. Contact the administrator.
reasons.approval_pending: This document is waiting for approval
reasons.date_before_last_issued: The document date cannot be before the latest number of the same series.
reasons.invalid_pattern: The number pattern is not valid.
reasons.invalid_tax_id: The tax id is not valid. Check the 13 digits again.
reasons.duplicate_customer: An active customer already uses this tax id and branch
reasons.customer_archived: This customer is archived; restore it before editing
reasons.already_responded: This link has already been answered
reasons.respond_not_supported: This document cannot be answered from a link
reasons.action_not_supported: This document does not take that answer
reasons.project_code_exists: This project already has a code
reasons.duplicate_project_code: Another project already uses this code
reasons.project_does_not_compute: The current BOQ does not compute; check the BOQ page
reasons.baseline_already_locked: The BOQ baseline is already locked
reasons.baseline_not_locked: The BOQ baseline is not locked
reasons.baseline_unlock_blocked: The baseline cannot be unlocked because documents already refer to it
reasons.no_cost_codes: The project has no cost codes to allocate the contract value to
reasons.commitment_exceeded: The release is larger than the open commitment
reasons.already_reversed: This entry has already been reversed
reasons.reversal_entry: A reversal entry cannot be reversed
reasons.financial_events_exist: This cannot be done because financial transactions have been recorded
reasons.draft_exists: This quotation already has a draft. Issue or cancel it first.
reasons.valid_until_before_issue_date: The valid-until date cannot be before the issue date.
reasons.per_category_vat_with_discount: VAT per category cannot be combined with a discount.
reasons.per_category_vat_with_rounding: VAT per category cannot be combined with rounding.
reasons.government_requires_included_vat: A government quotation must include VAT in Factor F.
reasons.included_vat_requires_government: VAT included in Factor F is only for government quotations.
reasons.government_with_discount: A government quotation cannot have a discount.
reasons.government_with_rounding: A government quotation cannot be rounded.
reasons.government_without_parts: A government quotation needs at least one part.
reasons.government_duplicate_part: Two parts have the same key.
reasons.government_bad_factor: Factor F must be greater than 0.
reasons.government_section_without_part: A category in the price is not in any part.
reasons.government_section_in_many_parts: A category is in more than one part.
reasons.government_unknown_section: A part refers to a category that does not exist.
reasons.discount_exceeds_subtotal: The discount is larger than the subtotal.
reasons.line_without_section: An item does not belong to any category.
reasons.duplicate_section: Two categories have the same number.
